deliverables.description: A documented style guide covering content presentation rules and development/maintenance procedures for website content.

information_nodes.description: The scope and purpose of the style guidelines to be developed, including which website content areas they cover.
Any current or prior style documentation, brand conventions, or content standards available in the workspace.
Organizational or client requirements that constrain how website content should be styled and documented.
Identify the distinct categories of website content and the content elements (text, headings, links, media, metadata) that the style guidelines must address.
Define the specific stylistic rules for each content category and element, covering voice, tone, grammar, formatting, and presentation consistency.
Determine the procedures by which the style guidelines are applied, reviewed, and updated during website development and maintenance.
Define the document structure and organization that makes the style guidelines usable and referenceable for web content work.

work_objective: Develop and document style guidelines that specify how website content should be presented and maintained consistently.

deliverables.description: A completed three-dimensional CAD model representing the specified mechanical part or assembly, with geometry, features, and spatial relationships defined per the design requirements.

information_nodes.description: Instructions describing the mechanical part or assembly to be modeled, including geometric features, dimensions, tolerances, and material considerations.
Existing two-dimensional drawings, sketches, or schematics depicting the part geometry, views, and dimensional annotations to be interpreted for 3D modeling.
information_nodes.modality_rationale: Interpret two-dimensional drawing views, dimensions, and annotations to determine the three-dimensional geometry, feature placement, and spatial relationships of the part

information_nodes.description: Interpret the design specifications and reference drawings to determine the required three-dimensional geometry, features, dimensions, tolerances, and spatial relationships of the part or assembly.

Select the appropriate CAD modeling strategy, including coordinate system setup, feature creation order, and modeling techniques (e.g., parametric, direct, surface) needed to accurately represent the part geometry.

Build the three-dimensional model geometry by creating and combining features such as extrusions, revolves, cuts, fillets, patterns, and assemblies according to the determined modeling approach and translated specifications.

modality_hypotheses.information_needed: Orthographic views, sectional views, dimensional annotations, and geometric relationships shown on reference drawings
modality_hypotheses.modality_rationale: Interpret two-dimensional drawing views, dimensions, and annotations to determine the three-dimensional geometry, feature placement, and spatial relationships of the part

work_objective: Produce a three-dimensional mechanical model using computer-aided design (CAD) software.

deliverables.description: A three-dimensional and/or interactive digital model that represents the architectural design's geometry, spatial arrangement, and key built elements, suitable for visualizing the design.

information_nodes.description: The user's instruction specifying the design to represent and the intended three-dimensional and/or interactive representation.
Architectural drawings (plans, elevations, sections, or sketches) defining the design's dimensions, forms, and arrangement.
Design specifications or design brief describing materials, scale, functional requirements, or constraints relevant to the representation.
Derive the three-dimensional spatial organization, dimensions, and geometric relationships of the design from the supplied drawings and specifications.
Produce the structured geometric data (coordinates, forms, surfaces, volumes) needed to construct the three-dimensional model.
Determine how structural, architectural, and site elements are represented, including level of detail, materials, and appearance appropriate to the requested representation.
Decide the representation approach (fully three-dimensional model versus interactive representation) that best satisfies the task request and design intent.

modality_hypotheses.information_needed: Two-dimensional geometric relationships, dimensions, orientations, and spatial arrangement of design elements.

work_objective: Create a three-dimensional or interactive digital representation of an architectural design using computer-assisted design software.
